title: The high shelf
starting_code: # Bring the rare book down with a spell.
hints: Walk to stand right beneath the rare book.
Use the `cast` method with the string "fendra" to pull the book down to you.
The spell brings it to your feet, so you must still use the `pick_up` method.
intro: There is a glowing rare book on top of that high bookcase, out of our reach. I have wanted it down for a long time! Walk under it and cast the *fendra* spell to draw it down to you.
outro: You have it! The spell worked perfectly.
learned: Now you know how the *fendra* spell reaches a thing in a straight line, and that a thing it brings must still be picked up.
